description: A tiny cute enchanted diving bell fish-catching automaton. One squat pear-shaped warm copper and cream brass bell body, soft rounded top, two tiny dark oval eyes directly in shell and a small warm smile. Bottom is a broad teal rubber flotation ring integrated with body. Two tiny simple brass scoop hands tucked beside the bottom, short small round top knob. Body like a chubby friendly bell, big simple readable shapes, minimal metal seams. Whimsical antique fishing gadget, not submarine, not crab, not humanoid. Single standalone sprite, transparent background, full body visible centered with padding. Cozy 16-bit game pixel art, deliberately chunky clean pixel clusters, restrained 3 shade palette, dark navy selective outline, saturated colors, no dithering, no soft blur. Three-quarter side view facing left. Very small compact adorable aquatic catching helper, no humanoid body, no square head, no long robot arms, no large porthole, no fish being caught, no water, no text, no speech bubble. Designed for 40 pixel tall in-game display.
